source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floors supplied: z_floor=0 and ceiling_height=3.0m are explicit assumptions.
Door heights 0-2.1m and window sill/head 0.9-2.4m assumed (standard, not observed in plan).
Wall thickness 240mm per plan labels; interior partitions represented at measured stroke centerlines.
Opening widths from measured cyan jamb runs; swing directions from arcs, door leaf states unknown.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Southeast suite (zoneA + SE workroom) has no door to the corridor as drawn: it connects only via D7 between them and exterior doors D_Rdouble/D_b2; corridor dead-ends at the y752 stub pocket. Verified against crops but unusual - kept as drawn.
W_top, W_Rband, W_Lband are ~4.8m continuous cyan bands; mullion subdivision into multiple windows not separable at this resolution.
Right-hand dimension aggregate labels (4060/1940/5940/3120/4940) not individually re-verified; fine-chain ticks were verified instead.
D4 leaf/arc geometry read as single door; arcs could indicate double-acting leaf. Room roles inferred from furniture only.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

Interior partitions placed at measured gray-stroke centerlines (drawn ~7px): y298.5, y370.5, y406.5, y585, y698, y752, x399.5, x459.5, x463. Opening spans from measured cyan jamb runs; door/window heights not in plan (see assumptions).
